intro: No ENT 211 past papers were found in the course folder. These exam-style questions were written for practice from the module slides; they are not from a past paper.

papers.paper: Exam-style questions, not from a past paper: written for this app from the ENT 211 module slides
papers.source: Written for this app from the ENT 211 module slides, because no past papers were found for the course

questions.text: a) Explain the contributions of Cantillon, Say, Schumpeter and Drucker to the theory of entrepreneurship. (8 marks) b) Discuss three myths about entrepreneurship and the reality behind each. (6 marks)
a) Describe the stages of the entrepreneurial process. (8 marks) b) Distinguish between classical, corporate, social and digital entrepreneurship, with an example of each. (6 marks)
a) Discuss five roles of the entrepreneur. (5 marks) b) What is an entrepreneurial ecosystem? Describe its components. (9 marks)
Discuss the challenges and prospects of entrepreneurship development in Nigeria. (14 marks)
a) Distinguish between creativity, innovation and entrepreneurship. (6 marks) b) Explain the seven steps of the creative process. (8 marks)
a) Explain incremental, breakthrough and disruptive innovation, with examples. (6 marks) b) Describe four types of intellectual property. (8 marks)
a) What is a business plan? Describe its key components. (9 marks) b) Why is a business plan crucial for a start-up? (5 marks)
a) Describe the nine elements of the Business Model Canvas. (9 marks) b) What is an elevator pitch, and what makes a great pitch? (5 marks)
a) Distinguish between an ethical issue and an ethical dilemma, with examples. (6 marks) b) Explain four approaches to resolving ethical dilemmas. (8 marks)
a) Explain the 3Ps of responsible business, using a Nigerian company as an example. (6 marks) b) Describe Carroll's pyramid of CSR. (8 marks)
a) Compare sole proprietorships, partnerships and incorporated companies. (9 marks) b) State five sources of business law in Nigeria. (5 marks)
a) Discuss five legal issues an entrepreneur must consider when starting a business in Nigeria. (10 marks) b) What is a start-up under the Nigerian Start-up Act 2022? (4 marks)
a) Distinguish between e-commerce and digital business. (5 marks) b) Explain the four e-commerce models with examples. (9 marks)
a) Describe five digital marketing channels. (10 marks) b) Explain the first three steps of a social media strategy. (4 marks)
